title: When should renting become buying?
hook: The stopping time matters most near the day you decide to buy.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Apply a rent-then-buy threshold and inspect the adversarial stopping time around that threshold.

misconception: Buying immediately or renting forever is always the safest online policy.
objective: Apply a rent-then-buy threshold and inspect the adversarial stopping time around that threshold.

claims.text: The adversary can stop just after the purchase decision, when both past rental and the purchase have been paid. Naming whether purchase day also incurs rent is essential. These durations test the boundary; they do not estimate a demand distribution.
